<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="marker-delimited-helper-guide">
<h1>Marker-Delimited Helper Guide</h1>
<p>The marker-delimited helper provides a simple, human-friendly way to mark text spans for
pronunciation overrides without complex syntax. It’s designed as a lightweight
alternative for users who don’t need full markup capabilities.</p>
<section id="overview">
<h2>Overview</h2>
<p>The marker system uses simple delimiters (like <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&#64;</span></code>) to mark text spans, then lets you
assign attributes to those spans using Python dictionaries. This two-step process
separates the marking from the attribute assignment.</p>
</section>
<section id="basic-usage">
<h2>Basic Usage</h2>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">kokorog2p.markers</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">parse_delimited</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">apply_marker_overrides</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">kokorog2p</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">phonemize</span>

<span class="c1"># Step 1: Parse marked text</span>
<span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;Ich mag @New York@. @Hi@ Klaus.&quot;</span>
<span class="n">clean_text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ranges</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">warnings</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">parse_delimited</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">marker</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;@&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="c1"># clean_text: &quot;Ich mag New York. Hi Klaus.&quot;</span>
<span class="c1"># ranges: [(8, 16), (18, 20)]  # Positions of &quot;New York&quot; and &quot;Hi&quot;</span>

<span class="c1"># Step 2: Assign attributes to marked spans</span>
<span class="n">assignments</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;nuː jɔːk&quot;</span><span class="p">},</span>      <span class="c1"># First marker: phoneme override</span>
    <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;lang&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;en-us&quot;</span><span class="p">},</span>        <span class="c1"># Second marker: language switch</span>
<span class="p">}</span>
<span class="n">overrides</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">apply_marker_overrides</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">clean_text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ranges</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">assignments</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Step 3: Phonemize with overrides</span>
<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">phonemize</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">clean_text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;de&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">overrides</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">overrides</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">phonemes</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="api-reference">
<h2>API Reference</h2>
<section id="parse-delimited">
<h3>parse_delimited</h3>
<p>Extracts marked spans from text and returns clean text with character offset ranges.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">parse_delimited</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">marker</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;@&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">escape</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="se">\\</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="p">):</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">&quot;&quot;&quot;</span>
<span class="sd">    Parameters:</span>
<span class="sd">        text (str): Input text with marker-delimited spans</span>
<span class="sd">        marker (str): Delimiter character (default: &quot;@&quot;)</span>
<span class="sd">        escape (str): Escape character for literal markers (default: &quot;\\&quot;)</span>

<span class="sd">    Returns:</span>
<span class="sd">        tuple: (clean_text, marked_ranges, warnings)</span>
<span class="sd">            - clean_text: Text with markers removed</span>
<span class="sd">            - marked_ranges: List of (char_start, char_end) tuples</span>
<span class="sd">            - warnings: List of warning messages (unmatched/nested markers)</span>
<span class="sd">    &quot;&quot;&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><strong>Examples:</strong></p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># Basic marking</span>
<span class="n">parse_delimited</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;I like @coffee@.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="c1"># (&#39;I like coffee.&#39;, [(7, 13)], [])</span>

<span class="c1"># Multiple marks</span>
<span class="n">parse_delimited</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;I like @coffee@ and @tea@.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="c1"># (&#39;I like coffee and tea.&#39;, [(7, 13), (18, 21)], [])</span>

<span class="c1"># Escaped marker (literal @)</span>
<span class="n">parse_delimited</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Email: user</span><span class="se">\\</span><span class="s2">@example.com&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="c1"># (&#39;Email: user@example.com&#39;, [], [])</span>

<span class="c1"># Unmatched marker (warning)</span>
<span class="n">parse_delimited</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Unmatched @marker&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="c1"># (&#39;Unmatched @marker&#39;, [], [&#39;Unmatched opening marker at position 10&#39;])</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="apply-marker-overrides">
<h3>apply_marker_overrides</h3>
<p>Converts marked ranges and attribute assignments to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">OverrideSpan</span></code> objects.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">apply_marker_overrides</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">clean_text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">marked_ranges</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">assignments</span><span class="p">):</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">&quot;&quot;&quot;</span>
<span class="sd">    Parameters:</span>
<span class="sd">        clean_text (str): Clean text from parse_delimited</span>
<span class="sd">        marked_ranges (list): List of (char_start, char_end) tuples</span>
<span class="sd">        assignments (list | dict): Attributes for each marker:</span>
<span class="sd">            - List: Applied in order (must match range count)</span>
<span class="sd">            - Dict: 1-based index mapping (e.g., {1: {...}, 2: {...}})</span>

<span class="sd">    Returns:</span>
<span class="sd">        list: List of OverrideSpan objects for phonemize</span>
<span class="sd">    &quot;&quot;&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><strong>Examples:</strong></p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">ranges</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[(</span><span class="mi">7</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">13</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">18</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">21</span><span class="p">)]</span>

<span class="c1"># List-based (in order)</span>
<span class="n">assignments</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;ˈkɔfi&quot;</span><span class="p">},</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;lang&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;en-us&quot;</span><span class="p">}]</span>
<span class="n">overrides</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">apply_marker_overrides</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ranges</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">assignments</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Dict-based (1-indexed)</span>
<span class="n">assignments</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;ˈkɔfi&quot;</span><span class="p">},</span>
    <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;lang&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;en-us&quot;</span><span class="p">}</span>
<span class="p">}</span>
<span class="n">overrides</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">apply_marker_overrides</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ranges</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">assignments</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Selective assignment (only second marker)</span>
<span class="n">assignments</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;lang&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;en-us&quot;</span><span class="p">}}</span>
<span class="n">overrides</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">apply_marker_overrides</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ranges</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">assignments</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="parsing-rules">
<h2>Parsing Rules</h2>
<section id="marker-pairing">
<h3>Marker Pairing</h3>
<p>Markers must come in pairs (opening and closing):</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;@word@&quot;</span>  <span class="c1"># Valid</span>
<span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;@word&quot;</span>   <span class="c1"># Invalid - unmatched marker (warning)</span>
<span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;word@&quot;</span>   <span class="c1"># Literal @ (no opening marker)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="escaping">
<h3>Escaping</h3>
<p>Use the escape character to include literal markers in text:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># Default escape character is backslash</span>
<span class="n">parse_delimited</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Email: user</span><span class="se">\\</span><span class="s2">@example.com&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">marker</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;@&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="c1"># Output: &quot;Email: user@example.com&quot; (no ranges)</span>

<span class="c1"># Custom escape character</span>
<span class="n">parse_delimited</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Price: 5|$&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">marker</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;$&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">escape</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;|&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="c1"># Output: &quot;Price: 5$&quot; (no ranges)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="nested-markers">
<h3>Nested Markers</h3>
<p>Nested markers are <strong>not supported</strong> and generate warnings:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;@outer @inner@ outer@&quot;</span>
<span class="n">clean_text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ranges</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">warnings</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">parse_delimited</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="c1"># Warning: &quot;Nested markers detected at position 14&quot;</span>
<span class="c1"># Result: Single range covering entire span</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><strong>Best Practice:</strong> Avoid nesting markers. Use non-overlapping spans instead.</p>
</section>
<section id="unmatched-markers">
<h3>Unmatched Markers</h3>
<p>Unmatched opening markers generate warnings and are kept as literal text:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;Start @unmatched end&quot;</span>
<span class="n">clean_text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ranges</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">warnings</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">parse_delimited</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="c1"># clean_text: &quot;Start @unmatched end&quot;</span>
<span class="c1"># ranges: []</span>
<span class="c1"># warnings: [&#39;Unmatched opening marker at position 6&#39;]</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="assignment-strategies">
<h2>Assignment Strategies</h2>
<section id="list-based-in-order">
<h3>List-Based (In Order)</h3>
<p>Use a list when you want to assign attributes in the order markers appear:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;I like @coffee@ and @tea@ and @water@.&quot;</span>
<span class="n">clean_text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ranges</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">warnings</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">parse_delimited</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Must provide exactly 3 assignments (one per marker)</span>
<span class="n">assignments</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span>
    <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;ˈkɔfi&quot;</span><span class="p">},</span>
    <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;tiː&quot;</span><span class="p">},</span>
    <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;lang&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;en-us&quot;</span><span class="p">},</span>
<span class="p">]</span>
<span class="n">overrides</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">apply_marker_overrides</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">clean_text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ranges</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">assignments</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><strong>Advantages:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Simple and concise for sequential assignments</p></li>
<li><p>No need to count marker positions</p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Limitations:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Must provide assignment for every marker</p></li>
<li><p>Cannot skip markers easily</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="dict-based-1-indexed">
<h3>Dict-Based (1-Indexed)</h3>
<p>Use a dict when you want selective or non-sequential assignment:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;I like @coffee@ and @tea@ and @water@.&quot;</span>
<span class="n">clean_text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ranges</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">warnings</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">parse_delimited</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Apply attributes only to markers 1 and 3 (skip marker 2)</span>
<span class="n">assignments</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;ˈkɔfi&quot;</span><span class="p">},</span>
    <span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;lang&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;en-us&quot;</span><span class="p">},</span>
<span class="p">}</span>
<span class="n">overrides</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">apply_marker_overrides</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">clean_text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ranges</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">assignments</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><strong>Advantages:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Selective assignment (can skip markers)</p></li>
<li><p>Explicit marker numbering (clearer intent)</p></li>
<li><p>Easier to modify/reorder</p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Limitations:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Must use 1-based indexing (not 0-based)</p></li>
<li><p>More verbose for simple sequential cases</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
</section>
<section id="attribute-types">
<h2>Attribute Types</h2>
<section id="phoneme-override-ph">
<h3>Phoneme Override (ph)</h3>
<p>Directly specify phonemes for a word:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;I like @pecan@ pie.&quot;</span>
<span class="n">clean_text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ranges</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">_</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">parse_delimited</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">assignments</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;pɪˈkɑːn&quot;</span><span class="p">}}</span>
<span class="n">overrides</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">apply_marker_overrides</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">clean_text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ranges</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">assignments</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">phonemize</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">clean_text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">overrides</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">overrides</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="c1"># &quot;pecan&quot; pronounced as /pɪˈkɑːn/</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="language-switch-lang">
<h3>Language Switch (lang)</h3>
<p>Switch language for specific words:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;I like @Bonjour@ and @Hola@.&quot;</span>
<span class="n">clean_text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ranges</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">_</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">parse_delimited</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">assignments</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;lang&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;fr&quot;</span><span class="p">},</span>
    <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;lang&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;es&quot;</span><span class="p">},</span>
<span class="p">}</span>
<span class="n">overrides</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">apply_marker_overrides</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">clean_text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ranges</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">assignments</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">phonemize</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">clean_text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;en-us&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">overrides</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">overrides</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="c1"># &quot;Bonjour&quot; uses French G2P, &quot;Hola&quot; uses Spanish G2P</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="combined-attributes">
<h3>Combined Attributes</h3>
<p>You can combine multiple attributes:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">assignments</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span>
        <span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;nuː jɔːk&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s2">&quot;speaker&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;male&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s2">&quot;emphasis&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;strong&quot;</span>
    <span class="p">}</span>
<span class="p">}</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><strong>Note:</strong> <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ph</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">lang</span></code> are special attributes handled by kokorog2p. Other attributes
are stored in token metadata for downstream processing.</p>
</section>
</section>
<section id="custom-markers">
<h2>Custom Markers</h2>
<p>You can use any single character as a marker:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># Using hash marks</span>
<span class="n">parse_delimited</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;I like #coffee#.&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">marker</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;#&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Using asterisks</span>
<span class="n">parse_delimited</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;I like *coffee*.&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">marker</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;*&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Using dollar signs</span>
<span class="n">parse_delimited</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Price: $100$ USD.&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">marker</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;$&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><strong>Best Practice:</strong> Choose markers that are unlikely to appear naturally in your text.</p>
</section>
<section id="common-patterns">
<h2>Common Patterns</h2>
<section id="handling-duplicate-words">
<h3>Handling Duplicate Words</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;@the@ cat @the@ dog&quot;</span>
<span class="n">clean_text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ranges</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">_</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">parse_delimited</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">assignments</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;ðə&quot;</span><span class="p">},</span>  <span class="c1"># First &quot;the&quot; (reduced)</span>
    <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;ði&quot;</span><span class="p">},</span>  <span class="c1"># Second &quot;the&quot; (emphasized)</span>
<span class="p">}</span>
<span class="n">overrides</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">apply_marker_overrides</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">clean_text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ranges</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">assignments</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">phonemize</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">clean_text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">overrides</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">overrides</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="multi-word-spans">
<h3>Multi-Word Spans</h3>
<p>Markers can wrap multiple words:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;I visited @New York City@ last year.&quot;</span>
<span class="n">clean_text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ranges</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">_</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">parse_delimited</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">assignments</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;nuː jɔːk ˈsɪti&quot;</span><span class="p">}}</span>
<span class="n">overrides</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">apply_marker_overrides</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">clean_text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ranges</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">assignments</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="mixed-language-text">
<h3>Mixed Language Text</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;Das ist @Machine Learning@ für @Performance@.&quot;</span>
<span class="n">clean_text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ranges</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">_</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">parse_delimited</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">assignments</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;lang&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;en-us&quot;</span><span class="p">},</span>  <span class="c1"># &quot;Machine Learning&quot;</span>
    <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;lang&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;en-us&quot;</span><span class="p">},</span>  <span class="c1"># &quot;Performance&quot;</span>
<span class="p">}</span>
<span class="n">overrides</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">apply_marker_overrides</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">clean_text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ranges</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">assignments</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">phonemize</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">clean_text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;de&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">overrides</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">overrides</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="error-handling">
<h2>Error Handling</h2>
<p>The marker system provides warnings rather than errors for robustness:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;@unmatched and @nested @marker@ here@&quot;</span>
<span class="n">clean_text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ranges</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">warnings</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">parse_delimited</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">warning</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">warnings</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">&quot;Warning: </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">warning</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="c1"># Warning: Unmatched opening marker at position 0</span>
<span class="c1"># Warning: Nested markers detected at position ...</span>

<span class="c1"># Text is still usable - warnings help debug issues</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><strong>When to Check Warnings:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>During development/testing</p></li>
<li><p>When user input quality is uncertain</p></li>
<li><p>For production validation</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="comparison-with-direct-span-creation">
<h2>Comparison with Direct Span Creation</h2>
<section id="using-markers-convenient">
<h3>Using Markers (Convenient)</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;I like @coffee@.&quot;</span>
<span class="n">clean_text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ranges</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">_</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">parse_delimited</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">overrides</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">apply_marker_overrides</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">clean_text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ranges</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;ˈkɔfi&quot;</span><span class="p">}})</span>
<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">phonemize</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">clean_text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">overrides</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">overrides</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="direct-spans-more-control">
<h3>Direct Spans (More Control)</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;I like coffee.&quot;</span>
<span class="n">overrides</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">OverrideSpan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">7</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">13</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;ˈkɔfi&quot;</span><span class="p">})]</span>
<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">phonemize</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">overrides</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">overrides</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><strong>When to Use Markers:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>User-facing applications where users mark text</p></li>
<li><p>Quick prototyping and experimentation</p></li>
<li><p>Text with many override regions</p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>When to Use Direct Spans:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Programmatic override generation</p></li>
<li><p>Precise offset control needed</p></li>
<li><p>Integration with external text processing pipelines</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
</section>

<h2>See Also</h2>

<li><p><a class="reference internal" href="../api/core/"><span class="doc">Core API</span></a> - Complete kokorog2p API documentation</p></li>
<li><p><a class="reference internal" href="../quickstart/"><span class="doc">Quick Start</span></a> - Getting started with kokorog2p</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
</section>
</div>
<script data-sphinxpress-script="search" defer>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  function initForm(form) {
    var input = form.querySelector(".tool-search-input");
    var results = form.querySelector(".tool-search-results");
    var navList = form.parentElement
      ? form.parentElement.querySelector(".tool-nav-list")
      : null;
    if (!input || !results) {
      return;
    }
    var emptyText = form.getAttribute("data-search-empty") || "No matches.";
    var indexUrl = form.getAttribute("data-search-index");
    if (!indexUrl) {
      hideForm();
      return;
    }

    var indexEntries = null;
    var indexError = false;
    var pendingQuery = null;

    function hideForm() {
      form.style.display = "none";
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      results.innerHTML =
        '<p class="tool-search-empty">' + escapeHtml(emptyText) + "</p>";
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function clearResults() {
      results.innerHTML = "";
      results.hidden = true;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = false;
      }
    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
